data.one_liner: A cross-platform WebView plugin for Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web, and OpenHarmony.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebView component supporting Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web, and OpenHarmony with an API compatible with webview_flutter. It enables loading URLs, HTML strings, executing JavaScript, and handling downloads across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need a WebView in a Flutter app targeting desktop and web in addition to mobile.
You want an API compatible with webview_flutter across all platforms.
avoid_when: You only need standard mobile platforms and prefer official platform-specific webview_flutter packages.
Your project does not require embedding web content inside the app.
strengths: Comprehensive support for all major desktop, mobile, web, and OpenHarmony platforms.
Includes features like download controls, private sessions, and custom JavaScript injection.
weaknesses: Relies on many underlying platform-specific sub-packages.
Platform-specific limits and behaviors apply as documented per target system.
data.setup_notes: Instantiate WebViewController with JavaScript mode and load a request, then pass to WebViewWidget.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need official mobile support and prefer the standard package maintained by the Flutter team.
